subject.title: fix(gateway): bound cross-boot restart-recovery with a persistent retry budget

question: Should subagent orphan recovery adopt a cumulative cross-boot accepted-attempt budget, or retain its existing two-minute rapid-rewedge fuse while only main-session recovery becomes cumulative?
rationale: The canonical issue requests both surfaces, but current main intentionally gives subagents a time-windowed fuse and the competing PR intentionally preserves it; choosing the permanent contract affects durable session state and Doctor/task-maintenance recovery.

options.title: Cumulative for both
options.body: Extend each recovery owner's existing fuse so accepted attempts remain cumulative across boots until successful progress or operator repair.

options.title: Main-session only
options.body: Land cumulative budgeting only for main sessions and preserve the current rapid-rewedge subagent contract.

options.title: Separate subagent follow-up
options.body: Land a guarded main-session fix first and require dedicated incident evidence before changing the subagent contract.

recommendation.title: Cumulative for both
recommendation.body: Extend each recovery owner's existing fuse so accepted attempts remain cumulative across boots until successful progress or operator repair.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is already actively reviewing the competing implementation and its recovery-contract tradeoffs.
